scope: ALL outbound links from Swing Shack marketing

mandatory_params.description: Every outbound link MUST carry these UTM parameters
mandatory_params.enforcement: BLOCK — link cannot be published without these

recommended_params.description: These params should be included where available
recommended_params.enforcement: WARN — link publishes but missing params are flagged

forbidden_params.description: These must never appear in UTM strings
forbidden_params.enforcement: BLOCK — these break attribution or are policy violations

instagram.utm_content_rule: MUST be hook_id — e.g. hook-a, hook-b, hook-c from A/B test
instagram.note: hook_id links post to specific A/B test variant for attribution

link_format.note: service param is added at the landing page level, not UTM

hook_id_mapping.description: hook_id values for A/B test variants — must be consistent across all channels

hooks.hook_a: Stats — YOUR GOLF STATS DON'T LIE
hooks.hook_b: Transformation — FROM CONFUSED GOLFER TO CONFIDENT STRIKER
hooks.hook_c: Convenience — RAIN OR SHINE YOUR GAME NEVER STOPS
hooks.hook_h: Club Speed — CLUB HEAD SPEED: 89 MPH

if_missing_mandatory.response: Link cannot be published. Return error: 'UTM parameters incomplete. Required: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content.'

if_missing_recommended.response: Link publishes but flag in analytics. Log: 'Recommended param missing.'

if_forbidden_param.response: Link cannot be published. Strip forbidden params first.

retroactive_enforcement.description: Existing posts are being retroactively tagged
retroactive_enforcement.priority_order: By reach — highest-reach posts tagged first

compliance_targets.one_week: 80%+ of all posts (including historical) have hook_id
compliance_targets.one_month: 95%+ of all posts have full UTM chain

honest_note: UTM enforcement is now active. All new outbound links will be checked. Historical posts are being retro-tagged. Until booking_confirmation fires in GA4, attribution remains WEAK_PROXY even with perfect UTMs.
